main.summary: Data protection with RSA and AES-GCM.

item.description: Header (variable length):
[0] : Version (1 byte)
[1] : Flags (1 byte)
[2..3] : RsaWrappedLen (UInt16)
[4..(4+R-1)] : RSA wrapped AES key + base nonce seed (R bytes)
[4+R] : chunksizepower (1 byte)
[opt] : OriginalLength (UInt64, 8 bytes) if Flag_HasOriginalLength
[opt] : AadHash (64 bytes) if Flag_HasAadHash
(Header length : see ComputeHeaderLength
Chunk (repeated zero or more times):
[0..3] : Plaintext length (UInt32)
[4..7] : Ciphertext length (UInt32)
[8..(8+C-1)] : Ciphertext (C bytes)
[8+C] : TagSize (1 byte, always 16)
[8+C+1..8+C+16] : GCM Tag (16 bytes)
Terminal record (always present, including for empty plaintext):
[0] : TerminalMarker (the existing marker value, 0xF0)
[1..8] : FinalChunkCount (UInt64)
[9..16] : TotalPlaintextLength (UInt64)
[17..32] : AES-GCM authentication tag (16 bytes)
Each chunk has an implicit zero-based UInt64 index derived from its order. Its nonce is derived via HMAC-SHA512(aeskey, basenonceseed || chunkindex) and truncated to 12 bytes.
Per-chunk AAD is a SHA512 hash of the version, flags, UInt64 chunk index, chunk plaintext length, and any present optional global fields.

The terminal record follows all chunks in both OriginalLength modes. Its count and total length are UInt64 big-endian values; its AES-GCM tag authenticates empty plaintext and binds the final count, total length, and header context.
OriginalLength, when present, must equal the total plaintext length observed while decrypting. It does not control whether the terminal record is present.
Successful decryption requires a valid terminal record and exact end-of-input; envelopes without the record or with trailing bytes are rejected.
All multi-byte integers are big endian.
Envelope = header + zero or more chunks + mandatory terminal record.
This prerelease V1 wire format is not compatible with earlier V1 envelopes that omit the terminal record.
VersionByte: Envelope version.
Flags: Bitfield indicating presence of optional fields (OriginalLength, AadHash).
RsaWrappedLen: Length of RSA-wrapped AES key + base nonce seed.
ChunkSizePower: Power-of-two chunk size (e.g., 20 for 1MB chunks).
HasOriginalLength: True if the original plaintext length is included in the header.
HasAadHash: True if a SHA512 hash of user-supplied AAD is included in the header.
OriginalLength: The original plaintext length (if present); when present it must equal the authenticated terminal record's total plaintext length.
AadHash: SHA512 hash of AAD (if present).
HeaderTotalLength: Total length of the parsed header in bytes.
Header context is authenticated by every content-chunk tag and by the mandatory terminal tag, including when there are no content chunks.
FinalChunkCount: The total number of authenticated content chunks, encoded as UInt64.
TotalPlaintextLength: The total recovered plaintext length in bytes, encoded as UInt64.
Tag: A 16-byte AES-GCM tag over empty plaintext.
The terminal record is mandatory, whether or not OriginalLength is included in the header, and is present for empty plaintext.
Its nonce is derived using FinalChunkCount as the next chunk index, distinct from all content-chunk nonces.
Its tag authenticates the terminal count, total length, and terminal AAD derived from the envelope header context.
The terminal record authenticates finality; the former marker and count alone were not an authenticator.

item.description: Read first 4 bytes (version, flags, rsaLen); validate version and flag bits.
Read rest of header (variable) and parse optional OriginalLength / AadHash.
RSA-OAEP decrypt wrapped material -> AES key + base nonce seed.
If AadHash present: compute SHA512(aad) and perform fixed-time equality check.
When OriginalLength is present, read and authenticate chunks until the declared number of plaintext bytes has been recovered; reject overrun, underrun, or malformed records.
When OriginalLength is absent, read and authenticate chunk records until the mandatory terminal marker is encountered; validate its final count and total length against observed values.
In either mode, authenticate the terminal tag and require exact end-of-input with no trailing bytes.
For each chunk:
a. Read plainLen, cipherLen, ciphertext, tagLen, tag.
b. Reject if plainLen != cipherLen or sizes exceed chunk size bound.
c. Derive nonce via HMACSHA512(aesKey, baseNonceSeed || chunkindex) -> first 12 bytes.
d. Build per-chunk descriptor and SHA512 hash -> perChunkAad.
e. AES-GCM decrypt and authenticate; on failure terminate and return false.
Ordering enforced via chunkindex in AAD.
Tampering with header context, lengths, ciphertext, chunk tags, terminal fields, or terminal tag triggers authentication or structural failure.
Replay or reordering of chunks invalid unless attacker can forge GCM tag.
Structural: truncated header, invalid lengths, unexpected EOF, missing or mismatched terminal record, or trailing bytes.
Cryptographic: RSA failure, GCM authentication failure, HMAC/AAD build errors.
Policy: Version mismatch, unsupported flags, chunk size overflow.

item.description: Validate arguments (stream capabilities, chunksizepower bounds, optional fields consistency).
Optionally determine original length (requires seekable input) when includeoriginallength = true.
Generate random AES-256 key and 16-byte base nonce seed; concatenate and RSA-OAEP(SHA-512) encrypt them.
Emit header: version | flags | rsawrappedlen | wrappedbytes | chunksizepower | [originallength?] | [aadhash?].
For each read chunk (up to chunkSize):
a. Derive per-chunk nonce = first 12 bytes of HMACSHA512(aeskey, basenonceseed || chunkindex).
b. Build per-chunk AAD descriptor (Version, Flags, ChunkIndex, PlainLength, [OriginalLength], [AadHash]) and hash with SHA512 -> perChunkAad.
c. Encrypt with AES-GCM(nonce, plaintextChunk, perChunkAad) -> ciphertextChunk, tag.
d. Write: UInt32 plainLen | UInt32 cipherLen | ciphertext | Byte tagLen (16) | tag.
After all chunks, write the mandatory terminal record containing the marker, UInt64 final chunk count, UInt64 total plaintext length, and AES-GCM tag over empty plaintext.
Confidentiality: AES-256-GCM with unique nonce per chunk derived from HMAC prevents reuse across indices.
Integrity and Authenticity: GCM tag covers ciphertext and per-chunk AAD which commits to ordering, lengths, version, flags, optional global fields.
Ordering: Chunk index hashed into per-chunk AAD prevents silent reordering or duplication.

Length / Truncation: The authenticated terminal count and total length detect truncation or extension in either OriginalLength mode; the header length, when present, is also checked against the observed total.
Finality: The mandatory terminal tag authenticates completion, including for empty plaintext; streaming output remains uncommitted until the terminal record verifies.
AAD Binding: If includeaadhash = true, user-supplied context is bound globally.

method.name: TryReadAndProcessHeaderAsync
method.summary: Reads and processes the envelope header from a stream asynchronously.
method.param: The input stream to read from.
The certificate with the private key for decryption.
The Additional Authenticated Data to validate against the header.
method.returns: A tuple containing the `Success` flag, parsed `Header`, and the decrypted 48-byte `KeyMaterial` buffer. On success, `KeyMaterial` contains the AES key followed by the base nonce seed; ownership transfers to the caller, which must zero it after use. On failure, the returned key material is null and all temporary sensitive buffers are cleared.
method.remarks:
This method performs the following asynchronous steps:
Reads the entire header from the stream.
Parses the header fields.
Decrypts the RSA-wrapped key material into one 48-byte buffer containing the AES key followed by the base nonce seed.
Validates the AAD hash if it is present in the header.
